about: Hand-written model turns for the consultation follow-up mission. They drive control flow; they are not captured Gemini output.

args.body: Hi ${mission.facts.first_name}, thanks for asking about a consultation. I can offer Tuesday at 10:00 or Thursday at 15:00. Which one suits you?

args.evidence: Chose Thursday 15:00 over a morning slot.

args.fact: Offering a discount makes hesitant contacts reply faster.
args.evidence: This contact replied after the follow-up.

args.body: Thank you, ${mission.facts.first_name}. Thursday at 15:00 is confirmed for your consultation. A coordinator will send the calendar invitation.

turns.text: Consultation confirmed for Thursday 15:00. Mission complete.
